title: Recipe 65 — Bounding an agent loop: limits, continuity, and honest warnings

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “An unbounded agent loop is an outage waiting for a trigger. This is the contract that bounds one.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the run beat.

beats.label: Type the recipe's bounded research agent
beats.cue: “Thirty-two lines, and the bounds are declared — not enforced by a wrapper you hope someone wired up.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Clean. Every bound in that spec is a field the schema knows about.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

groups.title: Beat 2 · the warning that tells the truth

beats.label: Compile and watch the warnings
beats.cue: “accepted-but-unwired: the compiler took the field, and is telling you nothing consumes it yet. Accepting silently would be the bug.”

beats.label: Read the output
beats.cue: “A warning class that exists specifically so a spec field can't quietly do nothing.”

beats.label: Type the emitted hook wiring
beats.cue: “And here is what the recipe says the loop's own lifecycle hooks compile down to.”

beats.label: Prove it parses
beats.cue: “Generated code you can read — a plain array, not a registration API.”
beats.command: bun -e 'const s = require("fs").readFileSync("live/hooks.ts","utf8"); new Bun.Transpiler({ loader: "ts" }).transformSync(s); console.log("live/hooks.ts: parses as TypeScript");'

verify.note: the recipe's emitted-hooks fence is syntactically valid TS

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “session-start, stop, pre-tool, post-tool — the loop's whole surface, as data.”

groups.title: Beat 3 · a bound the schema rejects

beats.label: Type an invalid limits block
beats.cue: “The recipe's own counter-example: `limits:` at the root is not a thing.”

beats.label: Add the bogus key
beats.cue: “Now the mistake — a plausible-looking field that the schema has never heard of.”

beats.label: Lint it
beats.cue: “Rejected by name: Unrecognized key 'limits'. A typo'd bound is worse than no bound, so this fails loudly.”

verify.note: exit 1 — spec validation failed: <root>: Unrecognized key(s) in object: 'limits'

beats.label: Read the rejection
beats.cue: “Strict-by-default is what makes a declared bound trustworthy.”

groups.title: One more thing · run it inside its bounds

beats.label: Run the bounded agent
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Give it something open-ended and watch it stop where the spec said it would.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs a model credential

beats.label: Ask for something unbounded
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The bound is the feature. An agent that runs forever is not more capable.”
beats.text: Research everything you can about this repository and don't stop until you're done.
